posts.title: DhanGame Welcome Bonus and Promo Code: What to Expect at Launch
posts.excerpt: DhanGame launches 23 July 2026 with an advertised welcome bonus of Rs 100-500 and a first deposit match up to 200%. Here's what's been announced ahead of launch, and what's still unconfirmed.
posts.author: AllYonoGuru Team
posts.content:
DhanGame is scheduled to join the AllYonoGuru network between 8:00 and 9:00 AM IST on 23 July 2026. Ahead of that launch, DhanGame's own pre-launch promotional materials have announced a welcome bonus and a first deposit offer. Here's exactly what's been advertised, and what's not yet confirmed.

## The Advertised Welcome Bonus: Rs 100-500

DhanGame's pre-launch materials list a welcome bonus in the Rs 100-500 range for new accounts. Offers structured this way are typically variable rather than a fixed amount — the exact figure a given player receives often depends on the signup method, an active promo code, or an account verification step. None of those conditions have been published yet, so treat the range as the advertised ceiling and floor rather than a guaranteed number until DhanGame's own terms page is live.

## First Deposit Bonus: Up to 200%

The first deposit offer is advertised as a match of up to 200% — meaning a deposit could be credited with up to double its value in bonus funds, subject to whatever cap and conditions DhanGame publishes at launch. A percentage match this size is on the higher end of what's typical for this category of app, which makes the fine print more important to check, not less.

Once DhanGame's full terms are available, verify the same three things we'd recommend checking on any deposit-linked offer:

- **Wagering requirement** — the multiplier you need to play through before any bonus-linked balance becomes withdrawable.
- **Expiry** — the window you have to meet that wagering requirement before the bonus is forfeited.
- **Withdrawal cap** — whether there's a ceiling on how much of the resulting balance can actually be withdrawn.

For a general walkthrough of how these terms work across rummy and card apps, see our [signup bonus guide](/blog/rummy-51-bonus-signup-bonus-explained).

## The Promo Code: Not Released Yet

DhanGame has said the promo and voucher code will be released inside the app itself once it goes live — there is no working code to share before launch, and any code circulating elsewhere before 23 July 2026 should be treated as unverified. Once DhanGame is live, check our [promo code page](/all-yono-games-promocode) for the current code.

## What's Still Unconfirmed

DhanGame hasn't launched yet, which means none of the above has been independently reviewed — the category, table formats, wagering terms, and safety information are all still pending. Our [DhanGame page](/dhangame) carries a live countdown to launch and will be updated with full details once the app is available to review.

## When Does DhanGame Launch?

DhanGame is expected between 8:00 and 9:00 AM IST on 23 July 2026. Check the [DhanGame page](/dhangame) for the live countdown and, once available, the launch-updates link.
